name: K
source:
K is a mysterious person in a suit of what appears to be armor. His face is hidden by a mask, and no one knows his name or his age - not even him.

[Spoiler]In the final route, Akane takes the "regular" K (Kyle's) place.[/spoiler]

[From [url=http://zeroescape.wikia.com/wiki/K]Zero Escape Wiki[/url]]
